svg.title: Enterprise SLM decoder architecture
svg.desc: Top-down architecture diagram showing token input flowing through embedding, RoPE positional encoding, N transformer blocks each with RMSNorm, multi-head attention, SwiGLU feed-forward, then a final norm, linear projection, softmax, and output probabilities. Residual skip connections bypass each sub-layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are input token IDs created in the enterprise SLM?')
sendPrompt('Explain the token embedding layer in model.py')
sendPrompt('How does RoPE positional encoding work in this model?')
sendPrompt('Why is RMSNorm applied before attention in this model?')
sendPrompt('Explain the multi-head attention block in model.py in detail')
sendPrompt('What does Add and Norm do in a transformer block?')
sendPrompt('How does the SwiGLU feed-forward layer work in model.py?')
sendPrompt('What does the second Add and Norm do after the FFN?')
sendPrompt('Why is there a final LayerNorm after all transformer blocks?')
sendPrompt('What is weight tying between the embedding and LM head in this model?')
sendPrompt('How does the softmax produce output probabilities?')
sendPrompt('What do the output probabilities represent in the enterprise SLM?')
